1.scope: 对象：物理、生物、心理学的科学综合是否已发生，且其对思想与社会习俗的影响是否深刻到可称为人类进化的一个阶段。窗口：1927–2026-11-15。可观察：交叉学科建制、思想/社会制度的重大变化。反证：三科仍分立、未出现被史家视为进化阶段的综合影响。
1.support: scientific synthesis physics biology psychology 20th century molecular biology neuroscience impact on thought society
1.counter: physics biology psychology remain separate disciplines no unified scientific synthesis human evolution stage

2.scope: 对象：生命与意识是否在1927年后不久进入“有理论依据的第一阶段控制”。可观察：对生命/意识的理论化干预（药物、遗传、神经技术）出现的时间。反证：长期内仍停留在经验试探，或‘不久’并未发生。
2.support: history of theoretically grounded control of life genetics medicine psychopharmacology timeline 1930s 1950s
2.counter: consciousness not under theoretical scientific control 20th century medicine still empirical

3.scope: 对象：量子定律是否在1927后不久被表述为可精确实验检验的明确不可逆形式。反证：主流量子力学保持幺正可逆（薛定谔/狄拉克），不可逆仅作为测量或近似。
3.support: quantum mechanics irreversible formulation Born 1920s 1930s time-reversal quantum laws history
3.counter: quantum mechanics unitary reversible Schrödinger equation time-reversal symmetry fundamental physics

4.scope: 对象：物理学家是否不久将原子用作物理学的理论时钟。可观察：原子钟发明与国际秒定义改用原子跃迁的时间。反证：时间标准仍以地球自转/历书时为主，或很晚才出现。
4.support: atomic clock history invention caesium second SI definition 1967 theoretical time standard
4.counter: earth rotation ephemeris time remained official time standard after 1927 atomic clocks delayed

5.scope: 对象：约1947年（二十年内）科学知识是否已足以开始‘人造人/受控再进化’这项巨型任务。可观察：1940年代合成生命/人造有机体的实际能力。反证：当时仅有简单有机合成，远未达人造人或活细胞合成。
5.support: origin of life research 1940s 1947 Miller Urey synthetic organism history knowledge adequate
5.counter: 1947 science could not create artificial life or synthetic man abiogenesis not achieved mid 20th century

6.scope: 对象：约1947年是否创立了国际进化研究所（International Institute of Evolutionary Research）并有公众捐款。反证：该机构不存在，或远晚于/完全不同。
6.support: International Institute of Evolutionary Research foundation 1930s 1940s League of Nations Switzerland
6.counter: no International Institute of Evolutionary Research founded 1940s Whyte 1927 prediction failed

7.scope: 对象：1927后数年之内，中枢神经系统生理学是否已能指出从最简单细胞到创造性思考者的综合/整合步数，并为各阶段归派觉知模式。反证：数年窗口内未完成，甚至至今仍不完整。
7.support: central nervous system physiology 1920s 1930s hierarchy of integration consciousness levels history
7.counter: how many levels of neural integration between cell and creative thought still unknown neuroscience 21st century

8.scope: 对象：1940年以前原子理论是否出现非常显著的简化，并表明量子过程中物理学已‘触底’（例如基本常量e,m,M,c,h的简单关系被确认）。反证：1930年代粒子与核物理使图像更复杂，常量关系未被接受。
8.support: atomic theory simplification before 1940 Eddington fundamental constants relations Dirac large numbers
8.counter: 1930s nuclear physics new particles neutron positron complexity atomic theory not complete 1940

9.scope: 对象：由偏转实验算出的‘电子速度’是否被发现不同于可直接测量的厘米/秒速度。反证：实验与相对论中电子速度与偏转结果一致，并不存在两种不等的速度量。
9.support: electron velocity deflection experiment vs direct measurement discrepancy history Kaufmann Bucherer
9.counter: electron speed measured consistently deflection experiments special relativity velocity cms per second

10.scope: 对象：直线电子径迹上测得的速度是否总是等于光速。反证：电子为有静质量粒子，速度可低于光速，云室/飞行时间测量证实v<c。
10.support: electron track velocity equal to speed of light measurement straight tracks
10.counter: electrons slower than light rest mass cloud chamber beta ray velocity less than c

11.scope: 对象：是否建立起适用于不可逆过程的新物理概念体系并取代牛顿可逆体系。可观察：基础物理定律是否改为不可逆形式。反证：相对论与量子力学在基本层面上仍时间可逆，牛顿被取代但并非被不可逆体系取代。
11.support: irreversible physics foundations replaced Newtonian mechanics 20th century Prigogine
11.counter: fundamental physics remains time-reversible quantum field theory general relativity CPT

12.scope: 对象：建立在电子速度实验上的新概念是否很快把化学结合与胶体过程纳入同一简单理论。可观察：量子化学统一化学键的时间与胶体科学是否同步纳入。
12.support: quantum chemistry chemical bonding unified theory 1927 1930s Heitler London Pauling colloids
12.counter: colloid science remained separate from quantum chemistry soft matter late 20th century

13.scope: 对象：生物学是否不久不再在无生命与生命体系之间划明确界线。可观察：生命定义、病毒、合成生物学、起源研究是否取消明确分界。反证：生物学仍使用生命/非生命二分。
13.support: biology blurred line living nonliving viruses origin of life definition 20th century
13.counter: biology still draws a definite distinction between living and non-living systems

14.scope: 对象：是否在每一类有机体中发现一种中枢控制过程，并以不可逆电化学过程较精确表述其定律（作者的生命函数f）。反证：未发现统一的f，控制是多种机制。
14.support: central controlling process organism electrochemistry homeostasis life function quantitative law
14.counter: no single central life function f discovered for each class of organism physiology

15.scope: 对象：影响生命函数f（中枢控制过程）的最重要因素是否在约1950年前为人所知。依赖f本身是否被建立。反证：1950年前并无被广泛接受的定量生命函数及其主控因素清单。
15.support: factors controlling organism vital processes known by 1950 metabolism hormones vitamins
15.counter: no quantitative life-function f or its main factors established by 1950 biology

16.scope: 对象：约1950年前癌症是否不仅可控制而且易于预防。反证：1950年癌症仍是主要死因，普遍预防与控制并未实现；即使到2026年也未‘易于预防’全部癌症。
16.support: cancer control prevention history 1950 survival rates early detection
16.counter: cancer not easily prevented or controllable in 1950 mortality statistics WHO historical

17.scope: 对象：分娩持续时间是否已被减至自然的最短限度。可观察：平均产程变化、催产素/剖宫产等干预。反证：产程并未被减至某一理论自然下限，或缩短方式与作者设想的提升活力不同且伴有医学化争议。
17.support: duration of childbirth labor length historical change oxytocin cesarean reduced labor time
17.counter: average length of labor not reduced to natural minimum obstetric interventions controversies

18.scope: 对象：特定遗传性疾病/虚弱倾向是否通过在受孕至成熟间加速或减缓发育速率而被克服。反证：主流手段是基因诊断、酶替代、基因治疗等，而非调控整体发育速率。
18.support: hereditary disease treated by accelerating or retarding development rate between conception and maturity
18.counter: genetic disease treatment gene therapy diet PKU not developmental rate modulation

19.scope: 对象：返老还童是否在1927后不久变得安全而有效（但不是不朽手段）。反证：当时‘返老’手术/激素疗法不安全或无效，现代抗衰老仍未达到安全高效的返老还童。
19.support: rejuvenation therapy history 1920s 1930s Steinach Voronoff hormone replacement safe efficient
19.counter: rejuvenation treatments 1920s 1930s discredited unsafe modern aging not reversed efficiently

20.scope: 对象：理论化生命科学是否逐步消灭了所有侵袭身体的器质性疾病。窗口1927–2026。可观察：传染病消灭、慢性病负担。反证：癌症、心血管、神经退行等器质性疾病仍广泛存在。
20.support: elimination of organic diseases 20th century smallpox vaccination antibiotics decline infectious disease
20.counter: chronic organic diseases cancer cardiovascular neurodegenerative still major causes of death 2020s WHO
